observation: Iterator-only and full candidate reproduce AArch64 raw slowdown with unchanged retired instruction counts, around 2.6x DSB-to-MITE penalty cycles, and increased DSB/MITE uop delivery; added-leaf-only and A/A controls stay close to baseline.
purpose: Test whether retired fusion/slot counts change, distinguish issued from retired work, and localize cycle samples by symbol.
controls: Same frozen source, consumer and five binary controls as R1474. Core-count availability is the only pre-build selection condition; all four attempts retained.
sampling: Two balanced forward/reverse rotations, same path/inode/length and disabled ASLR, 400 unchanged traversals, cycles:u sampling period 1000003. Resolve each report before replacing its executable. No sampling-derived throughput claims; non-precise cycle samples can skid.
limits: PMU covers the whole process. Event cycle counts can overlap and cannot be added to predict elapsed time. Unsupported events and zero denominators remain explicit.
